title: 0.13.0 shipped without the mandated DRIFT release note; add it to the CHANGELOG and correct the GitHub Release body
description: Quest 0.13.0 shipped 2026-10-07 without the release note QCLI-433 records as MANDATORY (opum-doc ruling seq 167, relayed 2026-10-02): "A workspace that installs quest 0.13.0 will see quest agents --check report DRIFT until it runs quest agents --update-instructions." Both places that should carry it are empty of it, measured after release: the v0.13.0 GitHub Release body (7136 bytes) and CHANGELOG.md 0.13.0 section at the v0.13.0 tag (108 lines) hold zero matches for update-instructions or drift. The note exists verbatim on QCLI-433 as the note titled "RELEASE NOTE FOR 0.13.0" and includes its WHY: 0.13.0 ships the migrate-from-backlog skill (QCLI-436) and adds a one-line pointer to it from the GENERATED quest skill, so the committed generated block is one revision behind the installed 0.13.0 CLI and quest agents --check exits 6 (a generated-content difference, not the version-only path that exits 0) until the ordinary remedy is run. Do: (1) add it to CHANGELOG.md under 0.13.0 as a dated post-release correction, marked as added after release, then land and promote; (2) raise the GitHub Release body edit as an operator pane question with the exact diff (github-release.mjs refuses to edit a published release by design), applying it once only on A.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CHANGELOG.md 0.13.0 section carries the DRIFT note as a dated post-release correction marked as added after release, landed on dev and promoted to main.

The v0.13.0 GitHub Release body edit is raised in the session pane with the exact diff (the lines to add and where); on A the diff is applied once with the stated command, and on B the record states it was held.
